entities.summary: Mehdi Huseynzade Sumgait City Stadium is a stadium in Sumqayit, Azerbaijan. It has a capacity of 10,047 and it is the new home of Sumgayit FK of the Azerbaijan Premier League. It is planned to open in 2023 and will replace the club's current home, Kapital Bank Arena.
